root_cause: When all 128 trajectories in Step 0 timed out at sandbox start without generating tokens (all_env_timeout_batch=true), rollout.generate() was never invoked. Consequently, vllm_rollout._last_sampling_transforms remained None. When agentic_grpo_learner._process_results attempted to invoke get_prefill_rescore_logps on the all-zero/empty completion tokens, vllm_rollout.py:289 raised RuntimeError: processed S_prefill must follow generate().
remediation: In agentic_grpo_learner.py and/or vllm_rollout.py, bypass get_prefill_rescore_logps when all trajectories are compact-filtered / zero-masked (raw_completion_lengths.sum() == 0 or self._last_sampling_transforms is None) and return zeros matching the prompt shape.
